what: The v2 Today page has not been built: the file is unchanged from master and is still the v1 page. It has only #next, #qotd, #exam and #score. It has no #mist, #study, #plan, #chal or #tests cards, no dialog#targetSheet or #tryOne, no calendar, no size chips and no SEC/DAYS countdown, and it draws one day's question instead of the twins. §3.2.8 page items 15-27 and today.md's page items all fail.
fix: Build Part 3.2 as pages-only in web/index.html, following the S3 brief on master, against the endpoints on v2/s3-server. Where an endpoint has not landed yet, the card should degrade quietly.

what: The first tap on a day's-question option sends POST /api/qotd straight away. §3.2.8 #23 and today.md T1 item 5 say the first tap only selects and Check sends the request.
fix: Put a separate select step and a Check button in front of UI.question's onAnswer, as part of the Today page build.

what: There is no per-card error or Retry. With /api/challenge aborted, no challenge card shows "Couldn't load the challenge." with Retry, and a failed /api/today has no shared Retry either (§3.2.8 #27).
fix: Give each card an error state, and one Retry that repaints every card fed by /api/today, as part of the page build.

what: test_flow.py does not print "all good": it stops with OverflowError: Python int too large to convert to SQLite INTEGER. The same failure happens on master, so it comes from S9 (words.daily_item seeds), not from S3.
fix: S9/Task 18 should clamp or hash words.daily_item seeds into SQLite's 64-bit range. It is outside S3's files, so report it to the owner.

what: The branch is not rebased onto master, which has 3 newer commits including 155d352 (S3 made pages-only). So the S3.md and S3-check.md in the worktree are the older 'server and pages' versions.
fix: The next builder should run git rebase master before starting the page work.

what: The branch diff touches only files S3 no longer owns: server/api_today.py, server/daily.py, server/checks/s3.py, server/test_flow.py and server/cache/twin_supply.json. They are the predecessor's commits, identical to v2/s3-server (helper Task 24).
fix: Merge the server half once, through v2/s3-server. When v2/s3 is merged after it, those commits should already be in master, leaving only web/index.html as S3's delta.
